title: Silver Saver Account: Higher Interest Rates for Larger Balances
summary: Silver Saver Account earns tiered APY: 2.5% on balances under $25,000, and 4.0% on balances at or above $25,000. Holding an eligible Business Rewards Card adds +0.1% (Silver), +0.3% (Gold), or +0.55% (Platinum) to the base APY, with example annual interest amounts provided.
faqs: What APY does a Silver Saver Account get with a balance under $25,000?
What APY applies when my Silver Saver balance is $25,000 or more?
How does an eligible Business Rewards Card change my Silver Saver APY?
What is the combined APY for each Business Silver/Gold/Platinum card at $25,000+ and under $25,000?
What annual interest examples does the document provide for balances like $24,000, $26,000, $40,000, and $100,000?
How can I avoid losing the higher APY tier if my balance drops below $25,000?
